title: Implement GitHub App signal router: build-time key injection, runtime token generation, and GitHub Actions secret wiring
description: a1000107 defines the architecture for routing moeb-source signals to GitHub Issues via a GitHub App compiled into the moeb binary. The implementation requires concrete changes across three layers: the Rust codebase (new routing module, MCP integration, build.rs directive), the GitHub Actions release workflow (secret injection at build time), and the moeb App registration details (App ID constant, installation ID discovery). None of these are currently present.
